verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a help-center heading listing "记忆" (memory) among Kimi's general features. It does not describe persistent custom instructions or user-set preferences that shape every response, so it counts only as an adjacent feature. No documentation, settings description, or hands-on report shows a custom-instructions capability for the assistant or Kimi Code.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can set persistent custom instructions and preferences that shape every response
